csv_scope_of_work: The projects are primarily located in various Cities/ Townships of Macomb County. Projects may also be located at other Counties within Metro Region. PROJECT WORK DESCRIPTION (description of the project): Work involved in the design of the project consists of: preparing plans and proposal documents for as-needed design services. The consultant may be required to design American Disability Act (ADA) complaint sidewalk ramps, Capital Preventive Projects and other design related projects. In addition, the consultant may be required to assist in the completion of design projects undertaken by the TSC and/or the Region.
